name: Kluboslavija: Turneja 2026
description: Ti si novi menadžer Kluboslavija turneje. Pet gradova, jedan bus — Avala, Niš, Štrand, Sarajevo, Guncati. Slažeš crew kao karte, preživljavaš random evente, izbegavaš bankrot. Avala 20. jun je boss level.

modules.index.html: HTML shell, meta viewport, app div, module script entry
modules.src/main.js: Game loop state machine: TUTORIAL → MACRO → EVENT_INTRO → BLOCK_PHASE → BLOCK_RESULT → EVENT_RESULT → WIN/GAMEOVER
modules.src/config.js: All game constants: cities, roles, synergies, contra-synergies, event pool, booking tiers, promo options, scoring bases
modules.src/state.js: State creation, localStorage save/load, highscore tracking
modules.src/input.js: Touch/click event normalization, centralized input setup
modules.src/audio.js: AudioManager: ambient oscillator, bass beat scaling, ding/buzz/dj sounds
modules.src/render.js: Canvas renderer: crowd meter, block progress, synergy flash
modules.src/ui.js: All DOM screens: start, tutorial, macroHQ, eventIntro, blockPhase, riskWarning, results, gameOver, win
modules.src/share.js: Web Share API + clipboard fallback with Avala CTA
modules.src/systems/synergies.js: calculateSynergies(block_cards) — positive and negative synergy resolution
modules.src/systems/events.js: rollEvent(), applyEvent() — random event system with mitigation
modules.styles/theme.css: CSS custom properties, Kluboslavija color palette
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, monospace font, full-screen app container
modules.styles/ui.css: Screen styles, buttons (min 44px), cards, booking offers
modules.styles/game.css: Canvas container, crowd meter animation, synergy flash, morale bar
